abstract: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital; rat race; tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining: the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere; hours relative to peers’ hours; standard vs. evening/night/weekend hours; and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show the gender gap in hours and career success is due mostly to gendered division of labor in household production.
abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据与劳动力调查的关联，我们首次提供了关于工时与职业发展关联（即工时与职业成功之间的正相关关系）且具有外部效度的严谨证据。基于三种理论（人力资本理论、竞争性工作理论、锦标赛理论），我们通过以下维度解析工时与职业发展的关联：当前企业内工时与其他企业工时的差异化效应；工时相对于同行的相对水平；标准工时与晚间/夜间/周末工时的差异；以及持续超长工时的重要性。结合时间使用调查数据，我们揭示工时与职业成功中的性别差异主要源于家庭生产中的性别分工。
title: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
title_zh: 工作时间、高管任命与性别：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据

abstract: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
abstract_zh: 利用美国人口普查全量数据，本文研究了20世纪初主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法的影响。三重差分估计结果表明，最低工资法的影响为零，这可能反映了就业抑制效应以及留在劳动力队伍中的工人存在的正向选择偏差。通过比较州界两侧县-行业层面的趋势，受影响县-行业单元的女性就业率下降约3.1%。我们进一步探讨了劳动力需求的自工资弹性如何随跨行业集中度变化、男女替代渠道以及婚姻状况异质性。
title: The Economics of Gender-Specific Minimum Wage Legislation
title_zh: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析
